query:
UPDATE bots
        SET name = COALESCE($2, name),
            handle = COALESCE($3, handle),
            description = COALESCE($4, description),
            avatar_url = COALESCE($5, avatar_url),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
          AND kind = 'system'
          AND deleted_at IS NULL
        RETURNING id
